entities.summary: The Hustynia Monastery of the Holy Trinity is a historical monastery located by the Udai river in the village of Hustynia near Pryluky in Ukraine. The monestry is famous for preserving in its walls the Hustyn Chronicle manuscript, which is an important source on Ukrainian history.
